full_title: Iron Outpost Blacksmith — Ch. 3 Forgeman & Armorer (ENV_R03)

demographics.proportions: ~150 cm tall (4.5 heads tall — slightly taller than Hero Kai at ~142 cm, shorter than Grandma Looma at ~156 cm, with ultra-wide stocky dwarf-craftsman shoulders)
demographics.build: Heavyset, barrel-chested, heavily muscled bare forearms and biceps dusted with forge soot and minor forge/battle scars

facial_features.face_shape: Broad rugged square elder craftsman face weathered by forge heat
facial_features.skin_tone: Warm ruddy tanned skin (#D99B78) with warm blush across nose and cheeks

hair.style: Thick silver-grey locks flowing behind ears beneath helmet rim, paired with bushy white eyebrows

beard_and_mustache.style: Massive triple-braided beard: wide sweeping walrus mustache flowing into one long central braid flanked by two shorter side braids bound near tips with brown leather/brass bands

eyes.shape: Focused intense eyes under heavy bushy silver eyebrows

forge_leather_apron.name: Forge Leather Apron Gear (Canonical Default)
forge_leather_apron.description: Iconic horned iron helmet, frayed sleeveless tunic, and heavy soot-smudged leather smithing apron

helmet.style: Domed riveted iron skullcap helmet (#6E7885) with central vertical and brow metal reinforcement straps
helmet.horns: Two short stout upward-curving ivory/bone horns (#DDD2BE) anchored in dark iron socket rings

tunic_and_trousers.tunic: Sleeveless jagged-frayed olive-slate rough linen undershirt (#58635A) exposing huge scarred arms

apron.color: Heavy thick saddle-brown leather smithing apron (#8A5A36) with dark forge soot smudges along lower hem
apron.details: Wide leather shoulder straps, chest bib tool pocket, and small brown hip belt pouch

gauntlets_and_boots.gloves: Thick cuffed brown leather smithing gauntlets (#6E482C)
gauntlets_and_boots.boots: Sturdy wide-cuffed dark brown leather calf boots (#5C3B24)

tools.hammer: Heavy rectangular forged steel smithing hammerhead (#6D747E) on sturdy hardwood shaft (#8A623E)
tools.tongs_and_anvil: Long articulated iron tongs gripping glowing white-orange blade blank over a horn-tipped iron anvil on an oak stump

ceremonial_guild_mail.name: Master Guild Chainmail & Tunic (Formal)
ceremonial_guild_mail.description: Retaining the horned steel helmet and triple-braided beard, wearing burnished steel chainmail hauberk over a forest-olive tunic with bronze buckle belt, leather gauntlets, and sheathed masterwork sword

mountain_travel_fur.name: Mountain Forge Travel Cloak (Outdoor)
mountain_travel_fur.description: Horned helmet, triple-braided beard, thick fur-lined brown bear-pelt shoulder cape fastened with iron brooches over sleeveless tunic and leather trousers, carrying war-smith hammer across shoulder

art_style_dna.primary_style: Hand-drawn fantasy storybook illustration, Studio Ghibli meets Akira Toriyama Dragon Quest art style
art_style_dna.line_art: Clean bold warm-sepia / charcoal ink outlines with natural organic lineweight
art_style_dna.shading_technique: Rich watercolor and painterly gouache washes with warm forge-ember highlights
art_style_dna.color_palette: Steel iron grey (#6E7885), ivory horn (#DDD2BE), silver-white beard (#C8CDD2), olive-slate tunic (#58635A), saddle-brown apron (#8A5A36), ember orange (#FF7A29), tan skin (#D99B78)
art_style_dna.atmosphere: Sturdy, warm, artisan pride, roaring hearth energy, dependable elder protector

do: Always include the riveted iron helmet with two upward-curving ivory horns and flowing grey hair out the back
Always render his thick triple-braided silver-white beard (one center braid + two side braids with leather cuffs) and sweeping mustache
Always keep his barrel-chested ~4.5 heads stocky proportions and heavily muscled scarred arms in a sleeveless frayed tunic + heavy brown leather apron
Always use Studio Ghibli x Dragon Quest clean ink and watercolor styling matching Hero Kai, Great Wizard, and Grandma Looma
dont: Do NOT draw him as a tall skinny youth or clean-shaven
Do NOT replace his triple-braided beard with an unbraided short goatee
Do NOT drop the horned riveted helmet or give him modern welder goggles/synthetic clothes
Do NOT render in photorealistic 3D CGI

canonical_v3_arc.distinct_from: Master Grimsby (ENV_R08 Deep Dwarven Forge, fiery red-orange beard, no horned helmet)
key_events: ENV_R03: Welcomes Hero Kai and the unnamed golden-tan pup at the Iron Outpost forge.

Demonstrates why comma weaving (print('Iron', 'Sword')) leaves a weak air gap and teaches the Plus Sign + fusion spell: print('Iron' + 'Sword') to meld two shattered blade halves into a gleaming solid IronSword.
